prompt: I'm a nurse and I want to really understand how mRNA vaccines work — like, from the basics to the actual molecular biology

assertions.text: Output contains all four depth levels (Level 1 through Level 4, or equivalent emoji/label markers)
A TL;DR or one-sentence summary appears near the top, before the level sections
Level 1 section uses no unexplained technical terms — suitable for a 10-year-old
The response ends with an invitation to go deeper or explore a related concept
At least one diagram, ASCII visual, Mermaid block, or structured illustration is included
Levels 3 and/or 4 use clinical or biological vocabulary appropriate for a nurse (e.g., ribosome, antigen, immune response, T cells, spike protein), rather than staying at a pure layperson level
